notes.1.26: The first word completes 'who ap-' at the end of the preceding line. 'N. [daughter] of N.' renders the blank formula (τὴν δεῖνα τοῦ δεῖνος) where the victim's name was to be written. Letters are doubtful in 'hear' (26), 'let ... hear' (27), 'Heliopolis' (30) and 'unapproachable' (34). 'Phagrōn polis' (city of the phagros fish?) and 'Habōnbos' are unidentified places. The purpose of 'burst and drain of blood' (28) is unclear. Losses in 33–34 leave those clauses incomplete.
